coordinate_space: stored global ZYX binary32; no tolerance weld

proof.pointwise_scope: every point of both closed triangular patch unions
proof.q_membership: nonnegative integer barycentric weights summing to the denominator
proof.identical_witness: [source_index, empty_path, target_index, 'identical'] means exact unordered corners match
proof.geometry_deduplication: unordered exact corner triples; orientation/multiplicity retained before extraction
proof.floating_arithmetic: nearest-point heuristic and ordering only; never used for acceptance

limits: Inconclusive means the sufficient proof did not finish; it is not a distance counterexample.
At an exact delta separation, positive-area parallel triangles may remain inconclusive at every finite depth.
This proves a distance bound, not equal area, identical surfaces, topology, no intersections or anatomical/fibre identity.
Only added patches are compared. Source retention is a separate exact oriented coordinate-multiset check.
The hard 384 MiB limit, desktop reserve and CPU/GPU restrictions must be supplied by the project guard.
